about: Curated stops for the Winnipeg to Thunder Bay and northern Ontario legs, placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. A stop whose season is not 'year round' is left out.

truck_access.about: Stops whose tractor-trailer access was read from a source (an hgv tag, a truck stop brand, or a truck stop or cardlock name), and those where it is assumed with the reason in source. The assumed ones are town stations and unnamed rest areas on long links with no truck source either way.
